description: Outdated draft inundation accounting figures returned
resolution_details: Updated report_service to return 8,663.80 ha persistent, 5,879.68 ha newly inundated, 65.36 ha receded, +5,814.32 ha net change over common valid domain, and 6,452.24 ha whole-epoch unmasked delta with 637.92 ha asymmetric mask gap.

description: Terminological inaccuracy describing July 16 observation as monsoon flood crest
resolution_details: Replaced monsoon flood crest with flood-period observation (mid-monsoon high stage, not peak of whole season) and preserved backwards-compatible alias.

description: Hardcoded transect counts (175 total / 53 ambiguous) misaligned with audit
resolution_details: Updated total evaluated transects to 154, valid local migration to 122, and outside valid-local to 32 (23 ambiguous edge effect, 5 anabranch activation, 4 major channel expansion).

description: Transect field naming station_m vs chainage_m
resolution_details: Added chainage_m field populated directly from audit CSV, preserving station_m as alias for backward compatibility.

description: Bootstrap confidence intervals falsely reported empirical [P10; P90] sample percentiles
resolution_details: Replaced [P10; P90] with authoritative 95% spatial block bootstrap intervals: West median [20.0; 80.0] m, East median [20.0; 150.0] m, Net Width median [120.0; 320.0] m.

description: Deprecated single 53.92m scalar reported as detection threshold
resolution_details: Replaced deprecated 53.92m scalar with 3-tier provisional scenario thresholds: 35.0m (cut-bank), 60.0m (nominal), 85.0m (char fringe).

description: Erosion candidate areas misaligned with Phase 6.1 general zones
resolution_details: Aligned candidate zones to Phase 6.1 general zones: Zone 2 External Bank Expansion (21.94 km2), Zone 3 Char Submergence (23.21 km2), Zone 4 Apparent Contraction (0.4148 km2), Zone 6 Disconnected Floodplain (13.6468 km2).

description: Channel change zones palette restricted to incorrect 4-class mapping
resolution_details: Expanded palette to authoritative 12-class geomorphic codebook (Classes 0-10 and 255 nodata).

description: Hardcoded EPSG:32645 string in raster metadata response
resolution_details: Dynamically extract CRS from dataset projection with fallback to EPSG:32645 if undefined.

description: NoData sentinel (-9990.0) rendered as visible opaque grayscale pixels
resolution_details: Added explicit sentinel filter (arr > -9990.0) to ensure nodata pixels render with alpha=0 (fully transparent).

description: Silently dropped tile rendering exceptions
resolution_details: Added logger.error with exc_info=True to record rendering failures on server side.

description: Native UTM coordinates returned in GeoJSON without standard WGS84 reprojection
resolution_details: Reprojected native EPSG:32645 coordinates to EPSG:4326 [lon; lat] using OSR CoordinateTransformation with traditional GIS order, preserving native_crs in response metadata.

description: Hardcoded region_id in vector response
resolution_details: Derived region_id dynamically from vector asset catalog entry.

description: Backend accepted arbitrary region_id and returned Jamuna data
resolution_details: Added strict validation in flood_service, riverbank_service, and report_service rejecting unknown regions with HTTP 404.

description: Backend accepted arbitrary model_id and returned Phase 7A data
resolution_details: Added model validation in model_service returning None/HTTP 404 for unknown model identifiers.

description: Decision margin |P - 0.5| misattributed as distance to decision threshold 0.35
resolution_details: Clarified decision margin as uncalibrated distance to symmetric 0.5 boundary, distinct from operational 0.35 threshold.

description: Missing Tuple import in job_service.py
resolution_details: Imported Tuple from typing.

description: verify_dataset_integrity bypassed actual SHA-256 computation
resolution_details: Implemented streaming SHA-256 calculation for registered files on disk, returning all_valid=False on missing or altered files.

description: checksum_verified reported True even when file missing from disk
resolution_details: Set checksum_verified=False and quality_status=FILE_MISSING when file does not exist on disk.

description: Stale precomputed analysis run metrics in database seed
resolution_details: Updated SQLite analysis_runs seed data with authoritative Phase 5 valid-domain figures, 154/122 transects, and ROC-AUC 0.6810.

description: Unsanitized exception handler leaking internal tracebacks
resolution_details: Sanitized global exception handler to log errors server-side and return generic safe JSON error response to client.

description: Duplicate system routing causing double /api/v1/api/v1 prefix
resolution_details: Mounted /health at root and normalized system routes under /api/v1/system/status and /api/v1/system/capabilities without duplicate prefixes.
